Name: Genshin Valley - New Crops
Author: prerona2411
Description:
Have you ever:

- been a Genshin player farming materials for your mains and thought 'Man, how cool would it be to actually grow these plants!' (No, the teapot doesn't count)
[b]OR[/b]
- been a humble Stardew Valley player who loves mods and thought 'Man, I want [i]even[/i] more crops in my game!'

I am both of the above people. So I decided to take matters into my own hands and draw plants from Genshin Impact, turning them into proper crops in Stardew Valley! 

[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=3]I tried to make all crop descriptions as general as possible, without referencing too much from Genshin Impact. While I enjoy the game, I want people who haven't played it to be able to enjoy the crops I made without having to figure out niche references![/size][/color][/b]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]How to Install!
[/b][/size][/color]- Make sure you have[b] [/b]everything under Requirements installed! (Only Multi Yield Crops is optional)
- Install this mod, unzip it and move it to your Mods folder (if updating, please [b]DELETE[/b] previous mod versions, do not overrwrite)

[color=#00ff00][b][size=4]CURRENT FEATURES[/size]
[/b][/color]- Several crops from Mondstadt, Liyue and Inazuma (the first three regions of Genshin Impact)
- A custom shop run by the iconic twins (open from Monday to Saturday, 6 am to 8 pm, in every season [b]except Winter[/b])

[color=#00ff00][b][size=4][u]NEW FEATURES IN 3.0.0[/u][/size][/b][/color]
[size=3]- [b]13 new crops [/b]and a [b]new fruit tree[/b]. 9 crops and the tree are from Sumeru, plus there are 3 mushrooms from the other 3 regions, and the good old crop found literally everywhere, Mint (renamed to Teyvatian Mint because I doubt you want like 5 crops with the same name).
- The closed shop now has a special little dog guarding it! That's it. The dog doesn't really do much, I just added it in because it's cute.[/size]

All the products have gift taste support for NPCs from Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, SVE and some standalone NPCs as well. 

[b]The crops and saplings (new additions in bold):[/b]
[spoiler]
Crops: Amakumo Fruit, Anemo Dandelion, Calla Lily, Cecilia Flower, Dendrobium, [b]Fluorescent Fungus[/b],[b] [/b]Glaze Lily, [b]Harra Fruit[/b], [b]Henna Berry[/b],[b] [/b]Jueyun Chili, [b]Kalpalata Lotus[/b], Liyue Lotus, [b]Mourning Flower[/b], Naku Weed, [b]Nilotpala Lotus[/b], [b]Padisarah[/b], [b]Philanemo Mushroom[/b], Qingxin, [b]Rukkhashava Mushroom[/b], Silk Flower,  Small Lamp Grass, Snapdragon, [b]Starshroom[/b], [b]Sumeru Rose[/b], [b]Teyvatian Mint[/b], Valberry, Violetgrass,  Windwheel Aster, Wolfhook, [b]Zaytun Peach[/b]

Saplings: [b]Ajilenakh Nut Sapling[/b], Lavender Melon Sapling,[b] [/b]Sunsettia sapling[b] [/b]
[/spoiler]

[size=3][b]Currently Translated into: 
[/b][/size]- Korean
- Traditional Chinese
- (a PT-BR translation is also in progress)

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Future Plans![/size][/color]
[/b]- Crops from whatever regions unlock in the future
- BAGI support [color=#00ff00][b](will start making soon!)[/b][/color]
- Forage (for non-plant objects like Sango Pearls) [b][color=#8e7cc3](tentative)[/color][/b]
- Custom Ore Nodes (for minerals like Cor Lapis) [b][color=#8e7cc3](tentative)[/color][/b]
[i](both forage and custom ore will only happen if i can figure out how they work in the game, since I'm still new to modding!)[/i]

This is my first proper mod, as well as my first dive into pixel art, so any feedback or bug reports would be valuable to me!
My mod also has an[b] i18n[/b] file! So if anyone wishes to[b] translate[/b] it, please let me know in the mod comments!
